name: Kalax
rootCause: Kalax, a yield aggregator on Blast, suffered a $350,000 loss on October 14, 2024, following a rugpull attributed to an admin drain. All evidence points to sudden fund removal by the founders with deletion of project channels, but no direct on-chain or contract technical mechanism is published. The Kalax protocol's controlling parties executed a rugpull, draining all funds via privileged access. The specifics of contract withdrawal permissions or technical vulnerabilities remain unverified, as no contract code, function implementation, or withdrawal transaction is published.
